title: A Network-Based Examination of the Longitudinal Association Between Psychopathy and Offending Versatility
limitations: - Reliance on self-report measures; - Limited number of data waves; - Potential for mono-operation bias; - Data were not collected via ESM/EMA methods.
notes: The study used longitudinal data from the Pathways to Desistance Study, which was not collected via ESM/EMA methods. The authors did not explicitly state whether the study was preregistered, but the data and code are available upon request. The study's focus on network analysis and centrality measures is a strength, but the data collection method is not intensive longitudinal.
